notes: Διὰ τοῦτο → 'Therefore' is one `noncompositional` unit headed on the demonstrative, neither token answering to the single English word (rule 45).
εἰσῆλθεν keeps only 'entered' because its own preposition εἰς is expressed and takes 'into' (rules 36 and 106).

καί → 'and' and οὕτως → 'so' are separate units: the καί here is the clause connective standing before οὕτως, not the answering particle of a οὕτως … καί correlative, so rule 100's whole-correlative clause is not in play.
ἐφ' ᾧ is rendered by two English words, so the pair is not one unit (rule 94).
